changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RollupPathSegment') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathSegment]( [RollupPathUid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [Position] int NOT NULL, [AssetTypeID] int NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricRollupPathSegment] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [RollupPathUid] ASC, [Position] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricRollupPathSegment_MetricRollupPath') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathSegment] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricRollupPathSegment_MetricRollupPath] FOREIGN KEY([RollupPathUid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[RollupPath] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathSegment] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricRollupPathSegment_MetricRollupPath] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricRollupPathSegment_AssetType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathSegment] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricRollupPathSegment_AssetType] FOREIGN KEY([AssetTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[AssetType] ([ID]) ON DELETE NO ACTION ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathSegment] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricRollupPathSegment_AssetType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricRollupPathSegment_AssetTypeID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_MetricRollupPathSegment_AssetTypeID ON [metrics].RollupPathSegment ( AssetTypeID ASC ) END
